lines.transliteration: haadhaa limaadha u'allimuk al-a'daad — hattaa laa tukhti' fil-hisaab yawman

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قِف! لَيسَ كُلُّ مَن يَأتي إلى البَوَّابَة صَديقاً
lines.english: Halt! Not everyone who comes to the gate is a friend.
lines.transliteration: qif! laysa kullu man ya'tii ilaa al-bawaaba sadiiqan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحِصنُ — المَكانُ المَحمِيُّ. كَالقَلعَة لَكِن أَصغَر
lines.english: The fortress — a protected place. Like a castle but smaller.
lines.transliteration: al-hisn — al-makaan al-mahmiyyu. kal-qal'a laakin asghar
lines.culturalNote: Muslim military architecture reached its peak under Saladin. The Citadel of Cairo (built 1183 CE) used the same engineering principles as Crusader castles — in fact, Crusaders may have copied Muslim fortress designs.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الجُندِيُّ الجَيِّدُ لا يَحتاجُ سُيوفاً كَثيرَة — يَحتاجُ عَقلاً واحِداً صافِياً
lines.english: A good soldier doesn't need many swords — he needs one clear mind.
lines.transliteration: al-jundiyyu al-jayyid laa yahtaaju suyuufan kathiira — yahtaaju aqlan waahidan saafiyyan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قِف! ذاكَ يَكفي لِليَوم. عُدْ غَداً
lines.english: Halt! That's enough for today. Return tomorrow.
lines.transliteration: qif! dhaaka yakfii lil-yawm. ud ghadan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَدينَة مَحمِيَّة بِالأَسوار. تَعال أُريكَ
lines.english: The city is protected by walls. Come, let me show you.
lines.transliteration: al-madiina mahmiyya bil-aswaar. ta'aal uriika

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سور — الحائِط حَول المَدينَة. مِنهُ مَدينَة الصِّلاة السُّور في القُرآن
lines.english: Suur — the wall around a city. Also the name for Quran chapters (Sura).
lines.transliteration: suur — al-haa'it hawla al-madiina. minhu madiina
lines.culturalNote: The Arabic word "sura" (سورة), a Quran chapter, shares its root with "suur" (سور, wall). A sura is a section that stands complete on its own — like a walled enclosure that contains and protects what is within it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَلف حارِس حَرَسوا بَغداد في ذُروَتِها — أَعظَم مَدينَة في العالَم
lines.english: A thousand guards protected Baghdad at its peak — the greatest city in the world.
lines.transliteration: alf haaris harasuu baghdaad fii dhurwatihaa — a'zam madiina fil-'aalam

choices.english: Protecting the city is important! Thank you, Hamza.

personality.catchphrase: قِف! — qif! (Halt!)

name: Farmer Omar
role: Teaches nature and animal vocabulary

greeting.arabic: أَهْلًا! مَرْحَبًا فِي مَزْرَعَتِي!
greeting.english: Hello! Welcome to my farm!
greeting.transliteration: Ahlan! Marhaban fi mazra'ati!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا يَا صَدِيقِي! أَنَا عُمَرُ، المُزَارِعُ هُنَا.
lines.english: Hello my friend! I am Omar, the farmer here.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan ya sadiqi! Ana 'Umar, al-muzaari'u huna.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ الأَرْضُ طَيِّبَةٌ. الشَّمْسُ وَالمَطَرُ يَجْعَلَانِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ يَنْمُو.
lines.english: This land is good. The sun and rain make everything grow.
lines.transliteration: Hadhihi al-ardu tayyibah. Ash-shamsu wal-mataru yaj'alani kulla shay'in yanmu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَالَ، سَأُعَلِّمُكَ عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ. هَذِهِ هِيَ الشَّمْسُ.
lines.english: Come, I will teach you about nature. This is the sun.
lines.transliteration: Ta'aal, sa-u'allimuka 'an at-tabii'ah. Hadhihi hiya ash-shamsu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَحْتَاجُ المَطَرَ لِلزِّرَاعَةِ. المَطَرُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ.
lines.english: We need rain for farming. Rain is a blessing from God.
lines.transliteration: Nahtaaju al-matara liz-ziraa'ah. Al-mataru ni'matun min Allah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَةِ الكَبِيرَةِ! زَرَعْتُهَا بِنَفْسِي.
lines.english: Look at that big tree! I planted it myself.
lines.transliteration: Undhur ila tilka ash-shajarah al-kabiirah! Zara'tuha bi-nafsi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَيَّا نَرَى كَمْ تَعَلَّمْتَ عَنِ الطَّبِيعَةِ!
lines.english: Let's see how much you learned about nature!
lines.transliteration: Hayya nara kam ta'allamta 'an at-tabii'ah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ! تَعَالَ أُرِيكَ حَيَوَانَاتِي.
lines.english: You're back! Come, let me show you my animals.
lines.transliteration: 'Udta! Ta'aal uriika hayawaanaati.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذَا هُوَ الجَمَلُ. هُوَ قَوِيٌّ وَصَبُورٌ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ.
lines.english: This is the camel. He is strong and patient in the desert.
lines.transliteration: Hadha huwa al-jamalu. Huwa qawiyyun wa saburun fi as-sahraa'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَهَذَا الحِصَانُ. هُوَ أَسْرَعُ حَيَوَانٍ فِي المَزْرَعَةِ!
lines.english: And this is the horse. He is the fastest animal on the farm!
lines.transliteration: Wa hadha al-hisaanu. Huwa asra'u hayawaanin fi al-mazra'ah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الخَرُوفُ يُعْطِينَا الصُّوفَ الدَّافِئَ.
lines.english: The sheep gives us warm wool.
lines.transliteration: Al-kharuufu yu'tiina as-suuf ad-daafi'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالمَعْزَةُ تُعْطِينَا الحَلِيبَ اللَّذِيذَ!
lines.english: And the goat gives us delicious milk!
lines.transliteration: Wal-ma'zatu tu'tiina al-haliib al-ladhiidh!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حَسَنًا، دَعْنَا نَخْتَبِرُ مَعْرِفَتَكَ بِالحَيَوَانَاتِ!
lines.english: Alright, let's test your knowledge of animals!
lines.transliteration: Hasanan, da'na nakhtabiru ma'rifataka bil-hayawaanaat!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبًا مُجَدَّدًا! عِنْدِي حَيَوَانَاتٌ أُخْرَى لِتَتَعَلَّمَهَا.
lines.english: Welcome again! I have more animals for you to learn.
lines.transliteration: Marhaban mujaddadan! 'Indi hayawaanaatun ukhra li-tata'allamaha.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَقَرَةُ تُعْطِينَا الحَلِيبَ كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ.
lines.english: The cow gives us milk every morning.
lines.transliteration: Al-baqaratu tu'tiina al-haliib kulla sabaah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحِمَارُ يَحْمِلُ الأَشْيَاءَ الثَّقِيلَةَ. هُوَ صَدِيقُ المُزَارِعِ!
lines.english: The donkey carries heavy things. He is the farmer's friend!
lines.transliteration: Al-himaaru yahmilu al-ashyaa' ath-thaqiilah. Huwa sadiiqu al-muzaari'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِسْمَعْ! ذَلِكَ صَوْتُ الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
lines.english: Listen! That is the sound of the bird above the tree.
lines.transliteration: Isma'! Dhaalika sawtu at-tayri fawqa ash-shajarah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْسَنْتَ! هَيَّا نَرَى إِنْ كُنْتَ تَذْكُرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ!
lines.english: Well done! Let's see if you remember everything!
lines.transliteration: Ahsanta! Hayya nara in kunta tadhkuru kulla shay'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! الحَمْدُ لِلَّه على الحَصاد
lines.english: Welcome! Praise God for the harvest.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! al-hamdu lillaah ala al-hasaad

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الطَّبيعَةُ جَميلَة. دَعْني أُعَلِّمُك
lines.english: Nature is beautiful. Let me teach you.
lines.transliteration: at-tabii'a jamiila. da'nii u'allimuk

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شَجَرَة — يَعني tree
lines.english: Shajara — means tree.
lines.transliteration: shajara — ya'nii tree

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الزِّراعَةُ في الواحَةِ قَديمَة جِدّاً
lines.english: Farming in the oasis is very ancient.
lines.transliteration: az-ziraa'a fil-waaha qadiima jiddan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَجْدادي زَرَعوا هُنا مُنْذُ مِئات السِّنين
lines.english: My ancestors farmed here for hundreds of years.
lines.transliteration: ajdaadii zara'uu hunaa mundhu mi'aat as-siniin

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَصادُ هَذا العام مُمتاز!
lines.english: This year's harvest is excellent!
lines.transliteration: al-hasaad haadhaa al-aam mumtaaz!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَمْطارُ جاءَت في الوَقْت المُناسِب
lines.english: The rains came at the right time.
lines.transliteration: al-amtaar jaa'at fil-waqt al-munaasib

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العَرَبُ أَحدَثوا ثَورَةً زِراعيَّة — الرَّي وَتَناوُبُ المَحاصيل
lines.english: Arabs created an agricultural revolution — irrigation and crop rotation
lines.transliteration: al-arab ahdathu thawra zira'iyya — ar-ray wa tanawub al-mahasil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَلِمَةُ 'قُطن' أَعطَت 'cotton' وَ'سُكَّر' أَعطَت 'sugar'
lines.english: 'Qutn' gave 'cotton' and 'sukkar' gave 'sugar'
lines.transliteration: kalimat 'qutn' a'tat 'cotton' wa 'sukkar' a'tat 'sugar'
lines.culturalNote: English borrowed extensively from Arabic through trade: cotton (qutn), sugar (sukkar), orange (naranj), lemon (laymun), lime (lima), artichoke (al-kharshuf).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَ'نارَنج' أَعطَت 'orange' وَ'لَيمون' أَعطَت 'lemon'
lines.english: And 'naranj' gave 'orange' and 'laymun' gave 'lemon'
lines.transliteration: wa 'naranj' a'tat 'orange' wa 'laymun' a'tat 'lemon'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حَتّى كَلِمَةُ 'الجَبر' أَصبَحَت 'algebra' وَ'صِفر' أَصبَحَت 'zero'
lines.english: Even 'al-jabr' became 'algebra' and 'sifr' became 'zero'
lines.transliteration: hatta kalimat 'al-jabr' asbahat 'algebra' wa 'sifr' asbahat 'zero'
lines.culturalNote: The concept of zero (sifr) was transmitted to Europe through Arabic mathematicians. The word 'cipher' also comes from sifr.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهلاً وَسَهلاً! الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ على الحَصاد. تَعالَ أُريكَ شَيئاً عَجيباً
lines.english: Welcome! Praise God for the harvest. Come let me show you something amazing.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! al-hamdu lillaah ala al-hasaad. ta'aala uriika shay'an ajiiban

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَناةُ — قَناةٌ مائِيَّةٌ تَحتَ الأَرض. أَجدادُنا بَنَوها منذُ آلاف السِّنين
lines.english: The qanat — an underground water channel. Our ancestors built them thousands of years ago.
lines.transliteration: al-qanaat — qanaat maa'iyya taht al-ard. ajdaaduna banawha mundhu aalaf as-siniin
lines.culturalNote: Qanats are ancient underground water channels that bring groundwater from aquifers to the surface by gravity. They were invented in Persia and spread across the Islamic world. Some are still functional after 3,000 years.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الماءُ يَسيرُ تَحتَ الأَرض مِيلاتٍ بِقوَّةِ الجاذِبِيَّة. لا مَضَخَّات! لا كَهرُباء!
lines.english: Water travels underground for miles by gravity. No pumps! No electricity!
lines.transliteration: al-maa' yasiiru taht al-ard miilaat bi-quwwat al-jaadhibiyya. laa madhakhkhaat! laa kahrubaa'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَمدُ لِلَّه! هَذِهِ الواحَة تَعيشُ بِقَناةٍ بَناها جَدّي قَبلَ مِئَتَي سَنَة
lines.english: Praise God! This oasis lives by a qanat my grandfather built two hundred years ago.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah! haadhihi al-waaha ta'iishu bi-qanaat banaahaa jaddii qabl mi'atay sana

choices.english: This is amazing! I want to learn

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهلاً وَسَهلاً! الحَمدُ لِلَّه! سَأُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمات الأَرض
lines.english: Welcome! Praise God! I'll teach you the words of the earth.
lines.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! al-hamdu lillaah! sa-u'allimuka kalimaat al-ard

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَرض — هِيَ أُمُّ كُلِّ شَيء. مِنها نَأكُل وَإِلَيها نَعود
lines.english: Land — it is the mother of everything. From it we eat and to it we return.
lines.transliteration: ard — hiya ummu kull shay'. minhaa na'kul wa ilayhaa na'uud

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: زَرعَ — فِعلٌ مُقَدَّس. كُلُّ زَرعَةٍ صَدَقَة. هَكَذا قالَ النَّبيُّ عَلَيهِ السَّلام
lines.english: Planting — a sacred act. Every planted thing is charity. So the Prophet, peace be upon him, said.
lines.transliteration: zara'a — fi'lun muqaddas. kullu zar'atin sadaqa. haakadha qaala an-nabiyyu alayhis-salaam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالنَّخلَةُ — مَلِكَةُ الأَشجار في الصَّحراء. تُعطينا تَمراً وَظِلاً وَخَشَباً
lines.english: And the palm tree — queen of trees in the desert. It gives us dates, shade, and wood.
lines.transliteration: wan-nakhlatu — maliikat al-ashjaar fis-sahraa'. tu'tiinaa tamran wa dhillan wa khashaban

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: صَعبَة؟ الحَمدُ لِلَّه — كُلُّ حَياةٍ فيها صُعوبات. لَكِنَّ المُزارِعَ يَرى الثَّمَر
lines.english: Hard? Praise God — every life has difficulties. But the farmer sees the fruit.
lines.transliteration: sa'ba? al-hamdu lillaah — kullu hayaatin fiihaa su'uubaat. laakin al-muzaari' yaraa ath-thamar

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَزرَعُ اليَوم وَتَأكُلُ بَعدَ أَشهُر. الصَّبرُ هُوَ أَهَمُّ ما يَتَعَلَّمُهُ المُزارِع
lines.english: You plant today and eat after months. Patience is the most important thing a farmer learns.
lines.transliteration: tazra'u al-yawm wa ta'kulu ba'da ashhur. as-sabr huwa ahamm maa yata'allamuhu al-muzaari'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَمدُ لِلَّه على كُلِّ حَال — في الجَفاف وَفي المَطَر. هَذا ما عَلَّمَني أَبي
lines.english: Praise God in every situation — in drought and in rain. This is what my father taught me.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah ala kull haal — fil-jafaaf wa fil-matar. haadhaa maa allamanii abii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهلاً! الحَمدُ لِلَّه! هَل تَعلَمُ عَن الثَّورَة الزِّراعيَّة في الأَندَلُس؟
lines.english: Welcome! Praise God! Do you know about the agricultural revolution in Andalusia?
lines.transliteration: ahlan! al-hamdu lillaah! hal ta'lamu an ath-thawra az-ziraa'iyya fil-andalus?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العَرَبُ أَدخَلوا إلى أُوروبَّا: البُرتُقال وَالقُطن وَالقَصَب وَالأَرُزَّ
lines.english: Arabs introduced to Europe: orange, cotton, sugarcane, and rice.
lines.transliteration: al-arab adkhalu ila urubba: al-burtuqaal wal-qutn wal-qasab wal-aruzz
lines.culturalNote: The Arab Agricultural Revolution (700-1100 CE) transformed Spain and Sicily. Arabs introduced irrigation, new crops, and crop rotation. Over 10,000 Arabic words entered Spanish, mostly through agriculture and science.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَنَشَروا نِظامَ السَّقي بِالرَّوافِع وَالسَّواقي — الأَرضُ الجافَّة صارَت خَضراء
lines.english: And they spread irrigation systems with water wheels and channels — dry land turned green.
lines.transliteration: wa nasharu nidhaam as-saqii bir-rawaafia was-sawaaqii — al-ard al-jaaffa saarat khadhraa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَمدُ لِلَّه! المُزارِعُ يَزرَعُ وَالأَرضُ تُعطي — هَذِهِ بَرَكَةُ العَمَل
lines.english: Praise God! The farmer plants and the earth gives — this is the blessing of work.
lines.transliteration: al-hamdu lillaah! al-muzaari' yazra'u wal-ard tu'tii — haadhihi barakat al-'amal

personality.catchphrase: الحَمْدُ لِلَّه — al-hamdu lillaah (Praise be to God)

name: Herbalist Maryam
role: Teaches body parts and basic verbs

greeting.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ! تَفَضَّلْ، اِجْلِسْ هُنَا.
greeting.english: Peace be upon you! Please, sit here.
greeting.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum! Tafaddal, ijlis huna.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ. أَنَا مَرْيَمُ، العَشَّابَةُ.
lines.english: Peace be upon you. I am Maryam, the herbalist.
lines.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum. Ana Maryam, al-'ashshaabah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُدَاوِي النَّاسَ بِالأَعْشَابِ. لِذَلِكَ أَعْرِفُ أَجْزَاءَ الجِسْمِ جَيِّدًا.
lines.english: I heal people with herbs. That is why I know the body parts well.
lines.transliteration: Udaawi an-naasa bil-a'shaab. Li-dhaalika a'rifu ajzaa' al-jismi jayyidan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبْدَأْ مِنَ الأَعْلَى. هَذَا هُوَ الرَّأْسُ.
lines.english: Let's start from the top. This is the head.
lines.transliteration: Li-nabda' min al-a'la. Hadha huwa ar-ra'su.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اليَدُ هِيَ أَدَاتُكَ لِجَمْعِ الأَعْشَابِ.
lines.english: The hand is your tool for gathering herbs.
lines.transliteration: Al-yadu hiya adaatuka li-jam'i al-a'shaab.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالعَيْنُ تُسَاعِدُكَ عَلَى مَعْرِفَةِ النَّبَاتَاتِ الصَّحِيحَةِ.
lines.english: And the eye helps you identify the right plants.
lines.transliteration: Wal-'aynu tusaa'iduka 'ala ma'rifati an-nabaataat as-sahiihah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَيِّدٌ! لِنَتَأَكَّدْ أَنَّكَ حَفِظْتَ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَاتِ.
lines.english: Good! Let's make sure you memorized these words.
lines.transliteration: Jayyid! Li-nata'akkad annaka hafidta hadhihi al-kalimaat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ! الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. عِنْدِي المَزِيدُ لِأُعَلِّمَكَ.
lines.english: You're back! Thank God. I have more to teach you.
lines.transliteration: 'Udta! Al-hamdu lillah. 'Indi al-maziidu li-u'allimaka.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأُذُنُ مُهِمَّةٌ. بِهَا نَسْمَعُ صَوْتَ الرِّيحِ فِي الأَشْجَارِ.
lines.english: The ear is important. With it we hear the sound of wind in the trees.
lines.transliteration: Al-udhunu muhimmah. Biha nasma'u sawta ar-riih fi al-ashjaar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الفَمُ لِلْكَلَامِ وَالأَكْلِ. اِحْفَظْ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةَ!
lines.english: The mouth is for speaking and eating. Remember this word!
lines.transliteration: Al-famu lil-kalaam wal-akl. Ihfadh hadhihi al-kalimah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَلْبُ هُوَ مَرْكَزُ الحَيَاةِ. نَقُولُ: القَلْبُ السَّلِيمُ فِي الجِسْمِ السَّلِيمِ.
lines.english: The heart is the center of life. We say: a healthy heart in a healthy body.
lines.transliteration: Al-qalbu huwa markazu al-hayaah. Naquul: al-qalbu as-saliimu fi al-jismi as-saliim.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَطْنُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى طَعَامٍ صَحِّيٍّ. الأَعْشَابُ تُسَاعِدُ البَطْنَ!
lines.english: The stomach needs healthy food. Herbs help the stomach!
lines.transliteration: Al-batnu yahtaaju ila ta'aamin sihhiyy. Al-a'shaabu tusaa'idu al-batna!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمْتَازٌ! هَيَّا نَرَى كَمْ تَعْرِفُ الآنَ.
lines.english: Excellent! Let's see how much you know now.
lines.transliteration: Mumtaaz! Hayya nara kam ta'rifu al-aan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَبًا! اليَوْمَ سَنَتَعَلَّمُ أَفْعَالًا مُهِمَّةً لِلْجِسْمِ.
lines.english: Welcome! Today we will learn important verbs for the body.
lines.transliteration: Marhaban! Al-yawma sanata'allamu af'aalan muhimmah lil-jism.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَكَلَ. الجِسْمُ يَحْتَاجُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ طَعَامًا صَحِّيًّا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
lines.english: To eat. The body needs to eat healthy food every day.
lines.transliteration: Akala. Al-jismu yahtaaju an ya'kula ta'aaman sihhiyyan kulla yawm.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شَرِبَ. اِشْرَبِ المَاءَ كَثِيرًا، خَاصَّةً فِي الحَرِّ!
lines.english: To drink. Drink water often, especially in the heat!
lines.transliteration: Shariba. Ishrabi al-maa'a kathiiran, khaassatan fi al-harr!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَامَ. النَّوْمُ الجَيِّدُ يَشْفِي الجِسْمَ مِثْلَ الأَعْشَابِ!
lines.english: To sleep. Good sleep heals the body like herbs!
lines.transliteration: Naama. An-nawmu al-jayyidu yashfi al-jisma mithla al-a'shaab!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْسَنْتِ! لِنَخْتَبِرْ هَذِهِ الأَفْعَالَ.
lines.english: Well done! Let's test these verbs.
lines.transliteration: Ahsanti! Li-nakhtabir hadhihi al-af'aal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً يا عَزيزي. الصِّحَّةُ تاج
lines.english: Welcome, dear. Health is a crown.
lines.transliteration: ahlan ya aziizii. as-sihha taaj

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَيْفَ أُساعِدُك؟
lines.english: How can I help you?
lines.transliteration: kayfa usaa'iduk?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الجِسْمُ نِعْمَة مِنَ اللَّه. لِنَتَعَلَّم
lines.english: The body is a blessing from God. Let us learn.
lines.transliteration: al-jism ni'ma min allaah. linata'allam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَأْس — هَذا head
lines.english: Ra's — this is the head.
lines.transliteration: ra's — haadhaa head

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَد — هَذِهِ hand
lines.english: Yad — this is the hand.
lines.transliteration: yad — haadhihi hand

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَعْشابُ الطِّبِّيَّةُ مَوْجودَة في الواحَة
lines.english: Medicinal herbs are found in the oasis.
lines.transliteration: al-a'shaab at-tibbiyya mawjuuda fil-waaha

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلُّ نَباتٍ لَهُ فائِدَة
lines.english: Every plant has a benefit.
lines.transliteration: kull nabaat lahu faa'ida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْتاجُ مُساعَدَة في جَمْع الأَعْشاب
lines.english: I need help gathering herbs.
lines.transliteration: ahtaaju musaa'ada fii jam' al-a'shaab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِجْمَع خَمْسَة أَنواع وَعُدْ إِلَيّ
lines.english: Gather five types and return to me.
lines.transliteration: ijma' khamsa anwaa' wa ud ilayya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِجْلِسْ، يا صَديقي. أُحَدِّثُكَ اليَومَ عَنِ الشَّيْخِ الرَّئيسِ ابنِ سينا.
lines.english: Sit, my friend. Today I will tell you about the Master Sheikh, Ibn Sina.
lines.transliteration: Ijlis, ya sadiiqi. Uhaddithuka al-yawma 'ani sh-shaykhi ar-ra'iis Ibn Siina.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كانَ ابنُ سينا طَبيبًا وَفَيلَسوفًا عاشَ في القَرنِ العاشِرِ الميلادي.
lines.english: Ibn Sina was a physician and philosopher who lived in the 10th century CE.
lines.transliteration: Kaana Ibn Siina tabiibanwa failasoofan 'aasha fil-qarni al-'aashiri al-miilaadiyi.
lines.culturalNote: Ibn Sina (Avicenna, 980-1037 CE) wrote the Canon of Medicine (al-Qanun fi al-Tibb), a medical encyclopedia that remained the primary medical textbook in European universities until the 17th century.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كِتابُهُ القانونُ في الطِّبِّ كانَ يُدَرَّسُ في جامِعاتِ أُوروبَّا لِسِتِّمائَةِ سَنَةٍ!
lines.english: His book, the Canon of Medicine, was taught in European universities for six hundred years!
lines.transliteration: Kitaabuhu al-Qaanun fi at-Tibb kaana yudarrasu fi jaami'aat Uroobba li-sittimi'ati sanah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَكَلِمَةُ 'إكسير' في الإنجليزيَّةِ جاءَت مِنَ العَرَبيَّةِ: الإكسير.
lines.english: And the word 'elixir' in English came from Arabic: al-iksir.
lines.transliteration: Wa kalimat 'elixir' fil-injiliiziyyati jaa'at min al-'arabiyyah: al-iksir.
lines.culturalNote: The English word 'elixir' comes from Arabic 'al-iksir', itself from Greek 'xerion' (powder for wounds). Arab alchemists used it to describe miraculous healing substances, and the concept entered European medicine through Arabic translations.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَلَّمْنا 'نَظيف'. الجِسْمُ النَّظيفُ أَوَّلُ خُطْوَةٍ في الطِّبِّ.
lines.english: We learned 'clean'. A clean body is the first step in medicine.
lines.transliteration: Ta'allamnaa 'nadhiif'. Al-jismu an-nadhiifu awwalu khutwa fin-tibb.

choices.english: Tell me about the ancient hospitals

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَوَّلُ مُستَشفًى حَقيقيٍّ في العالَمِ كانَ في بَغداد سَنَةَ ثَمانِمائَةٍ وَعِشرينَ مِيلادِيَّة.
lines.english: The first real hospital in the world was in Baghdad in 820 CE.
lines.transliteration: Awwalu mustashfan haqiiqiyyin fil-'aalami kaana fi Baghdaad sanata thamaanmi'atin wa 'ishriina miilaadiiyyah.
lines.culturalNote: The Bimaristan (from Persian: 'place of the sick') was the Islamic world's hospital system. The Baghdad Bimaristan (820 CE) treated all patients free of charge, regardless of religion, race, or wealth — a revolutionary concept in medieval medicine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كانَ البيمارِستانُ يُعالِجُ الجَميعَ مَجَّانًا: المُسلِمَ وَالمَسيحيَّ وَاليَهوديَّ وَالفَقيرَ.
lines.english: The bimaristan treated everyone for free: Muslim, Christian, Jew, and the poor.
lines.transliteration: Kaana al-biimaaristaanu yu'aaliju al-jamii'a majjaanan: al-muslima wal-masiihiyya wal-yahuudiyya wal-faqiir.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كانَ فيهِ أَطِبَّاءُ مُتَخَصِّصونَ: لِلعيونِ، وَلِلعَقلِ، وَلِلجِراحَة.
lines.english: It had specialized doctors: for eyes, for the mind, and for surgery.
lines.transliteration: Kaana fiihi atibbaa'u mutakhassisoon: lil-'uyooni, walil-'aqli, walil-jiraahah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذا هو القَلبُ النَّابِضُ لِلحَضارَةِ الإسلامِيَّة — العِنايَةُ بِكُلِّ إنسان.
lines.english: This is the beating heart of Islamic civilization — caring for every person.
lines.transliteration: Haadha huwa al-qalbu an-naabidu lil-hadaarati al-islaamiyyah — al-'inaayatu bikulli insaan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: طَيِّب، هَيَّا نَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِماتٍ لِلصِّحَّةِ وَالجِسم.
lines.english: Good, let us learn words for health and the body.
lines.transliteration: Tayyib, hayya nata'allamu kalimaat lis-sihha wal-jism.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اليَدُ — بِها نَجمَعُ الأَعشابَ وَنَشفي المَرضى.
lines.english: The hand — with it we gather herbs and heal the sick.
lines.transliteration: Al-yadu — biha najma'u al-a'shaaba wa nashfi al-mardaa.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العَيْنُ — بِها نَتَعَرَّفُ عَلى نَباتاتِ الشِّفاء.
lines.english: The eye — with it we recognize healing plants.
lines.transliteration: Al-'aynu — biha nata'arrafu 'ala nabaataat ash-shifaa'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الرَّأسُ — إذا آلَمَ الرَّأسُ، جَرِّبْ زَيتَ الزَّيتون.
lines.english: The head — if the head aches, try olive oil.
lines.transliteration: Ar-ra'su — idhaa aalama ar-ra'su, jarrib zayta az-zaytoon.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عَظيم! لِنَختَبِرْ ما تَعَلَّمتَه.
lines.english: Excellent! Let us test what you have learned.
lines.transliteration: Addhiim! Li-nakhtabir maa ta'allamtah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرحَبًا يا عَزيزي. كَيفَ صِحَّتُك اليَوم؟
lines.english: Welcome, dear one. How is your health today?
lines.transliteration: Marhaban ya 'aziizi. Kayfa sihhhatuka al-yawm?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الصِّحَّةُ تاج عَلى رُؤوسِ الأَصِحَّاء. لا تَعرِفُ قيمَتَها إلا إذا مَرِضت.
lines.english: Health is a crown on the heads of the healthy. You only know its value when you fall ill.
lines.transliteration: As-sihha taaj 'ala ru'oosi al-asihha'. La ta'rifu qiimatahailla idhaa maridta.

personality.catchphrase: الصِّحَّةُ تاج — as-sihha taaj (Health is a crown)

name: Elder Tariq
role: Teaches time vocabulary

greeting.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا مُسَافِرُ. اِجْلِسْ مَعَنَا عِنْدَ النَّارِ.
greeting.english: Peace be upon you, traveler. Sit with us by the fire.
greeting.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum ya musaafir. Ijlis ma'ana 'inda an-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنَا طَارِقٌ، شَيْخُ هَذَا المُخَيَّمِ.
lines.english: I am Tariq, the elder of this camp.
lines.transliteration: Ana Taariq, shaykhu hadha al-mukhayyam.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ، نَقْرَأُ الوَقْتَ مِنَ النُّجُومِ وَالشَّمْسِ.
lines.english: In the desert, we read time from the stars and the sun.
lines.transliteration: Fi as-sahraa', naqra'u al-waqta min an-nujuum wash-shams.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ: اليَوْمُ. اليَوْمُ هُوَ هَدِيَّةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ.
lines.english: The first thing: the day. The day is a gift from God.
lines.transliteration: Awwalu shay': al-yawmu. Al-yawmu huwa hadiyyatun min Allah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَعِنْدَمَا تَغِيبُ الشَّمْسُ، يَأْتِي اللَّيْلُ بِنُجُومِهِ.
lines.english: And when the sun sets, the night comes with its stars.
lines.transliteration: Wa 'indama taghiibu ash-shamsu, ya'ti al-laylu bi-nujuumihi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الصَّبَاحُ هُوَ أَجْمَلُ وَقْتٍ. الهَوَاءُ بَارِدٌ وَالنُّورُ جَمِيلٌ.
lines.english: The morning is the most beautiful time. The air is cool and the light is beautiful.
lines.transliteration: As-sabahu huwa ajmalu waqt. Al-hawaa' baaridun wan-nuuru jamiil.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَيِّدٌ. لِنَرَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَفْهَمُ الوَقْتَ كَمَا نَفْهَمُهُ نَحْنُ.
lines.english: Good. Let's see if you understand time as we understand it.
lines.transliteration: Jayyid. Li-nara in kunta tafhamu al-waqta kama nafhamuhu nahnu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ إِلَيْنَا. الصَّحْرَاءُ تُعَلِّمُنَا أَنَّ الوَقْتَ ثَمِينٌ.
lines.english: You have returned to us. The desert teaches us that time is precious.
lines.transliteration: 'Udta ilayna. As-sahraa'u tu'allimuna anna al-waqta thamiinun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَسَاءُ هُوَ وَقْتُ الرَّاحَةِ وَالحِكَايَاتِ عِنْدَ النَّارِ.
lines.english: The evening is the time of rest and stories by the fire.
lines.transliteration: Al-masaa'u huwa waqtu ar-raahah wal-hikaayaat 'inda an-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اليَوْمَ نَحْنُ هُنَا. هَذَا هُوَ اليَوْمُ — الآنَ، هَذِهِ اللَّحْظَةَ.
lines.english: Today we are here. This is today -- now, this moment.
lines.transliteration: Al-yawma nahnu huna. Hadha huwa al-yawm -- al-aan, hadhihi al-lahdhah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: غَدًا سَنَرْحَلُ مَعَ الرِّيحِ. غَدًا دَائِمًا يَأْتِي.
lines.english: Tomorrow we will travel with the wind. Tomorrow always comes.
lines.transliteration: Ghadan sanarhalu ma'a ar-riih. Ghadan daa'iman ya'ti.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَمْسِ مَضَى وَلَنْ يَعُودَ. لَا تَنْدَمْ عَلَى أَمْسِ.
lines.english: Yesterday has passed and will not return. Do not regret yesterday.
lines.transliteration: Amsi mada wa lan ya'uud. La tandam 'ala amsi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ الفَرْقَ بَيْنَ اليَوْمِ وَغَدٍ وَأَمْسِ؟ لِنَرَ!
lines.english: Do you know the difference between today, tomorrow, and yesterday? Let's see!
lines.transliteration: Hal ta'rifu al-farqa bayna al-yawmi wa ghadin wa amsi? Li-nara!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا! جِئْتَ فِي الوَقْتِ المُنَاسِبِ. عِنْدِي كَلِمَاتٌ جَدِيدَةٌ.
lines.english: Welcome! You came at the right time. I have new words.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan! Ji'ta fi al-waqti al-munaasib. 'Indi kalimaatun jadiidah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّاعَةُ تَقِيسُ الوَقْتَ. كَمْ سَاعَةً مَشَيْتَ فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ؟
lines.english: The hour measures time. How many hours did you walk in the desert?
lines.transliteration: As-saa'atu taqiisu al-waqt. Kam saa'atan mashayta fi as-sahraa'?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأُسْبُوعُ فِيهِ سَبْعَةُ أَيَّامٍ. نَرْحَلُ كُلَّ أُسْبُوعٍ.
lines.english: The week has seven days. We travel every week.
lines.transliteration: Al-usbuu'u fiihi sab'atu ayyaam. Narhalu kulla usbuu'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشَّهْرُ يَبْدَأُ مَعَ القَمَرِ الجَدِيدِ. نَحْنُ نَتْبَعُ القَمَرَ.
lines.english: The month begins with the new moon. We follow the moon.
lines.transliteration: Ash-shahru yabda'u ma'a al-qamari al-jadiid. Nahnu natba'u al-qamar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِخْتِبَارٌ أَخِيرٌ عَنِ الوَقْتِ. أَنْتَ جَاهِزٌ!
lines.english: A final test about time. You are ready!
lines.transliteration: Ikhtibaarun akhiir 'an al-waqt. Anta jaahiz!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُم يا شاب. الحِكْمَةُ مَعَ التَّجْرِبَة
lines.english: Peace be upon you, young one. Wisdom comes with experience.
lines.transliteration: as-salaamu alaykum ya shaab. al-hikma ma'a at-tajriba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الصَّحْرَاءُ مُعَلِّمَةٌ قَاسِيَةٌ لَكِنَّهَا عَادِلَةٌ.
lines.english: The desert is a harsh teacher, but a fair one.
lines.transliteration: As-sahraa'u mu'allimatun qaasiyatun laakinnaha 'aadilah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تُعَلِّمُنَا الصَّبْرَ وَقِيمَةَ المَاءِ وَقِيمَةَ الوَقْتِ.
lines.english: It teaches us patience, the value of water, and the value of time.
lines.transliteration: Tu'allimuna as-sabra wa qiimata al-maa'i wa qiimata al-waqt.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِحْفَظْ هَذَا فِي قَلْبِكَ يَا صَدِيقِي.
lines.english: Keep this in your heart, my friend.
lines.transliteration: Ihfadh hadha fi qalbika ya sadiiqi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ القَرْيَةُ قَديمَة جِدّاً
lines.english: This village is very ancient.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi al-qarya qadiima jiddan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا رَأَيْتُ تَسْعينَ عاماً هُنا
lines.english: I have seen ninety years here.
lines.transliteration: ana ra'aytu tis'iin aaman hunaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَكانَ جَدّي هُنا قَبْلي
lines.english: And my grandfather was here before me.
lines.transliteration: wa kaana jaddii hunaa qablii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحِكْمَةُ لا تَأتي بِسُهولَة
lines.english: Wisdom does not come easily.
lines.transliteration: al-hikma laa ta'tii bi-suhuula

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِذْهَب وَتَعَلَّم مِن كُلِّ أَهْل القَرْيَة
lines.english: Go and learn from all the village people.
lines.transliteration: idh-hab wa ta'allam min kull ahl al-qarya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَمْثالُ العَرَبِيَّةُ حِكْمَة الأَجْداد
lines.english: Arabic proverbs are the wisdom of ancestors.
lines.transliteration: al-amthaal al-arabiyya hikmat al-ajdaad

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَثَل: العِلْمُ نور
lines.english: Proverb: Knowledge is light.
lines.transliteration: mathal: al-ilmu nuur

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِجلِس يا صَديقي. أَنظُر إلى السَّماء — كُلُّ نَجمٍ لَهُ اسمٌ عَربيٌّ قَديم.
lines.english: Sit, my friend. Look at the sky — every star has an ancient Arabic name.
lines.transliteration: Ijlis ya sadiiqi. Undhur ila as-samaa' — kullu najmin lahu ismun 'arabiyyun qadiim.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: النَّجمُ الأَحمَرُ الكَبيرُ؟ اسمُهُ الدَّبَران — مَعناهُ 'التَّابِع'.
lines.english: That large red star? Its name is al-Dabaran — it means 'the follower'.
lines.transliteration: An-najmu al-ahmaru al-kabiiru? Ismuhu ad-Dabaraan — ma'naahu 'at-taabi'u'.
lines.culturalNote: The star Aldebaran (alpha Tauri) gets its name from Arabic 'al-Dabaran' meaning 'the follower', because it appears to follow the Pleiades across the sky. Roughly two-thirds of all named stars have Arabic names, a legacy of Islamic Golden Age astronomy.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَذاكَ النَّجمُ العَملاق؟ يَدُ الجَوزاء. بِالإنجليزيَّةِ يُسَمُّونَهُ 'بيتِلجوز'.
lines.english: And that giant star? Yad al-Jawza'. In English they call it 'Betelgeuse'.
lines.transliteration: Wa dhaakin-najmu al-'amlaaqu? Yadu al-Jawzaa'. Bil-injiliiziyyati yusammuunahu 'Betelgeuse'.
lines.culturalNote: Betelgeuse comes from Arabic 'yad al-jawza'' meaning 'the hand of Orion' (al-Jawza' was the Arabic name for the Orion constellation). The name was corrupted through medieval Latin transliteration from 'Ibṭ al-Jauzā'' (armpit of Orion).

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: النُّجومُ هِيَ خَريطَتُنا في الصَّحراء. الشَّمالُ دائِمًا عِندَ نَجمِ القُطب.
lines.english: The stars are our map in the desert. North is always at the Pole Star.
lines.transliteration: An-nujoomu hiya khariitatuna fis-sahraa'. Ash-shamalu daa'iman 'inda najm al-qutb.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في الصَّحراءِ بِلا خَريطَةٍ، الجِهاتُ حَياتُكَ أو مَوتُكَ.
lines.english: In the desert without a map, the directions are your life or your death.
lines.transliteration: Fis-sahraa'i bilaa khariitatin, al-jihaatu hayatuka aw mawtuka.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشَّمالُ — نَجمُ القُطب يُرشِدُك. الجَنوبُ — ظِلُّكَ في الظُّهرِ يُشيرُ إليه.
lines.english: North — the Pole Star guides you. South — your shadow at noon points to it.
lines.transliteration: Ash-shamalu — najm al-qutbi yurshiduka. Al-janoob — dhilluka fidh-dhuhri yushiiru ilayhi.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشَّرقُ — مِن هُناكَ تَشرُقُ الشَّمسُ كُلَّ صَباح.
lines.english: East — from there the sun rises every morning.
lines.transliteration: Ash-sharqu — min hunaaka tashruku ash-shamsu kulla sabaah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الغَربُ — إلى هُناكَ تَغرُبُ الشَّمسُ. الغُروبُ أَجمَلُ لَحظاتِ الصَّحراء.
lines.english: West — there the sun sets. Sunset is the most beautiful moment in the desert.
lines.transliteration: Al-gharbu — ila hunaaka taghrubu ash-shamsu. Al-ghuroob ajmalu lahdhaat as-sahraa'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمتاز! هَيَّا نَختَبِرُ هَذِهِ الجِهات.
lines.english: Excellent! Let us now test these directions.
lines.transliteration: Mumtaaz! Hayya nakhtabiru hadhihi al-jihaat.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا صَديقي، أَشارِكُكَ حِكمَةَ أَجدادي — اِسمَع بِقَلبِكَ لا بِأُذُنَيكَ.
lines.english: My friend, I share with you the wisdom of my ancestors — listen with your heart, not your ears.
lines.transliteration: Ya sadiiqi, usharikuka hikmat ajdaadii — isma' biqalbika laa bi-udhunayik.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَثَلٌ بَدَوِيٌّ: 'اِسأَلْ عَن الرَّفيقِ قَبلَ السَّفَر، وَعَنِ الجارِ قَبلَ الدَّار'.
lines.english: A Bedouin proverb: 'Ask about the companion before the journey, and about the neighbor before the house'.
lines.transliteration: Mathalun badawiyyun: 'Is'al 'an ar-rafiiqi qabla as-safar, wa 'an al-jaari qabla ad-daar'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَمَثَلٌ آخَرُ: 'الصَّحراءُ لا تَرحَمُ الجاهِلَ، وَلا تَنسى الحَكيمَ'.
lines.english: And another proverb: 'The desert has no mercy on the ignorant, and does not forget the wise'.
lines.transliteration: Wa mathalun aakhar: 'As-sahraa'u la tarham al-jaahil, wa la tansa al-hakiim'.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَديمًا، كانَ البَدَوِيُّ يَحفَظُ الألفَ نَجم. اليَومَ، احفَظ أَربَعَةَ كَلِمات.
lines.english: Long ago, a Bedouin memorized a thousand stars. Today, memorize four words.
lines.transliteration: Qadiiman, kaana al-badawiyyu yahfadhu al-alfa najm. Al-yawm, ihfadh arba'ata kalimaat.

personality.catchphrase: الحِكْمَةُ مَعَ التَّجْرِبَة — al-hikma ma'a at-tajriba (Wisdom with experience)

name: Storyteller Noor
role: Teaches adjectives through stories

greeting.arabic: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! تَعَالَ وَاسْمَعْ قِصَّةً!
greeting.english: Welcome! Come and hear a story!
greeting.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan! Ta'aal wasma' qissah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا! أَنَا نُورٌ، الرَّاوِيَةُ. أَرْوِي القِصَصَ لِأَهْلِ المُخَيَّمِ.
lines.english: Hello! I am Noor, the storyteller. I tell stories for the people of the camp.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan! Ana Nuur, ar-raawiyah. Arwi al-qisas li-ahli al-mukhayyam.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي قِصَصِي حَيَوَانَاتٌ كَبِيرَةٌ وَصَغِيرَةٌ. لِنَبْدَأْ!
lines.english: In my stories there are big and small animals. Let's begin!
lines.transliteration: Fi qisasi hayawaanaatun kabiiratun wa saghiiratun. Li-nabda'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَانَ هُنَاكَ أَسَدٌ كَبِيرٌ يَعِيشُ فِي الجَبَلِ. كَبِيرٌ يَعْنِي... ضَخْمٌ!
lines.english: There was a big lion living in the mountain. Big means... huge!
lines.transliteration: Kaana hunaaka asadun kabiirun ya'iishu fi al-jabal. Kabiirun ya'ni... dakhm!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَكَانَتْ هُنَاكَ نَمْلَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ لَكِنَّهَا ذَكِيَّةٌ جِدًّا!
lines.english: And there was a small ant, but she was very smart!
lines.transliteration: Wa kaanat hunaaka namlatun saghiiratun laakinnaha dhakiyyatun jiddan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَسَدُ كَانَ قَوِيًّا. لَكِنَّ القُوَّةَ لَيْسَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ!
lines.english: The lion was strong. But strength is not everything!
lines.transliteration: Al-asadu kaana qawiyyan. Laakinna al-quwwata laysat kulla shay'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَلْ أَعْجَبَتْكَ القِصَّةُ؟ لِنَرَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَذْكُرُ الكَلِمَاتِ!
lines.english: Did you like the story? Let's see if you remember the words!
lines.transliteration: Hal a'jabatka al-qissah? Li-nara in kunta tadhkuru al-kalimaat!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدْتَ لِسَمَاعِ المَزِيدِ! عِنْدِي قِصَّةٌ أُخْرَى.
lines.english: You came back for more! I have another story.
lines.transliteration: 'Udta li-samaa'i al-maziid! 'Indi qissatun ukhra.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَانَ هُنَاكَ أَرْنَبٌ سَرِيعٌ وَسُلَحْفَاةٌ بَطِيئَةٌ.
lines.english: There was a fast rabbit and a slow turtle.
lines.transliteration: Kaana hunaaka arnabun sarii'un wa sulahfaatun batii'ah.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَرِيعٌ! الأَرْنَبُ يَرْكُضُ كَالرِّيحِ!
lines.english: Fast! The rabbit runs like the wind!
lines.transliteration: Sarii'! Al-arnabu yarkudu kar-riih!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بَطِيءٌ! السُّلَحْفَاةُ تَمْشِي بِبُطْءٍ، لَكِنَّهَا لَا تَتَوَقَّفُ.
lines.english: Slow! The turtle walks slowly, but she never stops.
lines.transliteration: Batii'! As-sulahfaatu tamshi bi-but', laakinnaha la tatawwaqaf.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي النِّهَايَةِ، السُّلَحْفَاةُ فَازَتْ! كَانَتْ سَعِيدَةً جِدًّا!
lines.english: In the end, the turtle won! She was very happy!
lines.transliteration: Fi an-nihaayah, as-sulahfaatu faazat! Kaanat sa'iidatan jiddan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالأَرْنَبُ كَانَ حَزِينًا لِأَنَّهُ خَسِرَ.
lines.english: And the rabbit was sad because he lost.
lines.transliteration: Wal-arnabu kaana haziinan li-annahu khasir.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قِصَّةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ! هَلْ تَذْكُرُ الكَلِمَاتِ؟
lines.english: A beautiful story! Do you remember the words?
lines.transliteration: Qissatun jamiilah! Hal tadhkuru al-kalimaat?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا! عِنْدِي قِصَّةٌ أَخِيرَةٌ لَكَ.
lines.english: Hello! I have one last story for you.
lines.transliteration: Ahlan! 'Indi qissatun akhiiratun laka.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ، النَّهَارُ حَارٌّ جِدًّا كَالنَّارِ.
lines.english: In the desert, the daytime is very hot like fire.
lines.transliteration: Fi as-sahraa', an-nahaaru haarrun jiddan kan-naar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَاللَّيْلُ بَارِدٌ كَالمَاءِ. هَكَذَا هِيَ الصَّحْرَاءُ.
lines.english: And the night is cold like water. That is how the desert is.
lines.transliteration: Wal-laylu baaridun kal-maa'. Haakadha hiya as-sahraa'u.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: بَعْضُ القِصَصِ سَهْلَةٌ وَبَعْضُهَا صَعْبَةٌ. لَكِنَّ كُلَّهَا جَمِيلَةٌ!
lines.english: Some stories are easy and some are difficult. But all of them are beautiful!
lines.transliteration: Ba'du al-qisas sahlatun wa ba'duha sa'bah. Laakinna kullaha jamiilah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَهْلٌ. هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةُ سَهْلَةٌ، أَلَيْسَ كَذَلِكَ؟
lines.english: Easy. This word is easy, isn't it?
lines.transliteration: Sahlun. Hadhihi al-kalimatu sahlatun, alaysa kadhaalik?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: صَعْبٌ. لَا تَقْلَقْ، مَعَ التَّدْرِيبِ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يَصِيرُ سَهْلًا!
lines.english: Difficult. Don't worry, with practice everything becomes easy!
lines.transliteration: Sa'bun. La taqlaq, ma'a at-tadriib kullu shay'in yasiiru sahlan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذَا آخِرُ اِخْتِبَارٍ! أَنْتَ مُسْتَعِدٌّ!
lines.english: This is the final test! You are ready!
lines.transliteration: Hadha aakhiru ikhtibaarr! Anta musta'idd!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً! يُحْكى أَنَّ اليَوْمَ يَوْمٌ جَميل لِلقِصَص
lines.english: Welcome! It is said that today is a beautiful day for stories.
lines.transliteration: ahlan! yuhkaa anna al-yawm yawmun jamiil lil-qisas

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَرْوِيَ القِصَصَ! وَعِنْدَنا نُصوصٌ لِلقِراءَة أَيْضًا
lines.english: I love telling stories! And we have reading passages too.
lines.transliteration: uḥibbu an arwiya al-qiṣaṣ! wa-ʿindanā nuṣūṣ li-l-qirāʾa ayḍan

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القِراءَةُ تُساعِدُكَ على تَعَلُّمِ كَيْفَ تَتَرابَطُ الكَلِمات
lines.english: Reading helps you learn how words connect together.
lines.transliteration: al-qirāʾa tusāʿiduka ʿalā taʿallum kayfa tatarābaṭ al-kalimāt

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَرِّبْ تَمارينَ القِراءَة مِن قائِمَةِ 'أَنْشِطَة' في قائِمَةِ الإيقاف
lines.english: Try the reading exercises from 'Activities' in the pause menu.
lines.transliteration: jarrib tamārīn al-qirāʾa min qāʾimat 'anshiṭa' fī qāʾimat al-īqāf

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يُحْكى أَنَّ هُناكَ كَنْز قَديم مَدْفون في الصَّحْراء
lines.english: It is said that there is an ancient treasure buried in the desert.
lines.transliteration: yuhkaa anna hunaaka kanz qadiim madfuun fis-sahraa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: البَعْضُ يَقولُ إِنَّهُ ذَهَب، وَالبَعْضُ يَقولُ كُتُب
lines.english: Some say it's gold, and some say books.
lines.transliteration: al-ba'd yaquulu innahu dhahab, wal-ba'd yaquulu kutub

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لَكِنْ لا أَحَد وَجَدَهُ بَعْد
lines.english: But no one has found it yet.
lines.transliteration: laakin laa ahad wajadahu ba'd

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الكَلِماتُ الوَصْفِيَّةُ تَجْعَل القِصَص جَميلَة
lines.english: Descriptive words make stories beautiful.
lines.transliteration: al-kalimaat al-wasfiyya taj'al al-qisas jamiila

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَبير — big، صَغير — small
lines.english: Kabiir — big, saghiir — small.
lines.transliteration: kabiir — big, saghiir — small

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعْتُ قِصَّة عَن تاجِر مِن بِلاد بَعيدَة
lines.english: I heard a story about a trader from faraway lands.
lines.transliteration: sami'tu qissa an taajir min bilaad ba'iida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَقولُ إِنَّ هُناكَ مُدُن مِن ذَهَب!
lines.english: He says there are cities of gold!
lines.transliteration: yaquulu inna hunaaka mudun min dhahab!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِسمَعْ! اِسمَعْ! سَأَحكي لَكَ عَن أَعظَمِ راوِيَةٍ في التَّاريخ — شَهرَزاد!
lines.english: Listen! Listen! I will tell you about the greatest storyteller in history — Scheherazade!
lines.transliteration: Isma'! Isma'! Sa-ahki laka 'an a'dhami raawiiyatin fit-taariikh — Shahrazaad!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كانَت شَهرَزادُ تَحكي قِصَّةً كُلَّ لَيلَةٍ لِتُنقِذَ حَياتَها. أَلفُ لَيلَةٍ وَلَيلَة!
lines.english: Scheherazade told a story every night to save her life. One Thousand and One Nights!
lines.transliteration: Kaanat Shahrazaadu tahki qissatan kulla laylatin li-tunqidha hayaatahaa. Alfu laylatin wa laylah!
lines.culturalNote: One Thousand and One Nights (Alf Layla wa Layla) is a collection of Middle Eastern folk tales compiled during the Islamic Golden Age. Stories like Sinbad the Sailor, Aladdin, and Ali Baba reflect real 9th-century trade routes across the Indian Ocean and Silk Road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَقِصَّةُ السِّندِباد؟ السِّندِبادُ مُسافِرٌ شُجاعٌ — يَعني شُجاع، جَريء!
lines.english: And the story of Sinbad? Sinbad is a brave traveler — meaning brave, courageous!
lines.transliteration: Wa qissatu as-Sindibaad? As-Sindibaadu musaafirun shujaa' — ya'ni shujaa', jarii'!
lines.culturalNote: The name 'Sinbad' may derive from 'Sind-bad' meaning 'river of the Indus' in Persian/Sanskrit, reflecting the real Indian Ocean trade routes Arab merchants sailed. The Sinbad tales preserve genuine geographical knowledge of 9th-century maritime trade.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القِصَصُ لَيسَت مُجَرَّدَ تَسليَة — هِيَ تاريخٌ وَجُغرافيا وَحِكمَة!
lines.english: Stories are not mere entertainment — they are history and geography and wisdom!
lines.transliteration: Al-qisasu laysat mujarrada tasliya — hiya taarikhun wa jughraafiya wa hikmah!

choices.english: Teach me descriptive words from the stories
Tell me more about One Thousand and One Nights

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في كُلِّ قِصَّةٍ جَيِّدَةٍ، هُناكَ وَصفٌ رائِعٌ. دَعني أُعَلِّمَكَ!
lines.english: In every good story, there is wonderful description. Let me teach you!
lines.transliteration: Fi kulli qissatin jayyidatin, hunaaka wasfun raa'i'. Da'ni u'allimaka!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَديد — كَأَنَّ الصَّباحَ الجَديد يَفتَحُ بابًا جَديدًا لِكُلِّ مُسافِر.
lines.english: New — as if the new morning opens a new door for every traveler.
lines.transliteration: Jadiid — ka-anna as-sabaaha al-jadiida yaftahu baaban jadiidan li-kulli musaafir.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَديم — القِصَصُ القَديمَةُ هِيَ الأَجمَل. مِثلُ الخَمرِ، تَزدادُ جَمالًا مَعَ الزَّمَن!
lines.english: Old — the old stories are the most beautiful. Like wine, they grow more beautiful with time!
lines.transliteration: Qadiim — al-qisasu al-qadiimatu hiya al-ajmal. Mithlu al-khamri, tazdaadu jamaalan ma'a az-zaman!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: طَويل — القِصَّةُ الطَّويلَةُ تَملَأُ اللَّيلَ بِأَكمَلِه!
lines.english: Long — a long story fills the entire night!
lines.transliteration: Tawiil — al-qissatu at-tawiilatu tamla'u al-layla bi-akmalihi!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَصير — وَالقِصَّةُ القَصيرَةُ تَترُكُ شَوقًا لِلمَزيد!
lines.english: Short — and the short story leaves you longing for more!
lines.transliteration: Qasiir — wal-qissatu al-qasiiratu tatruqu shawqan lil-maziid!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الآنَ لِنَختَبِرُ الأَلوانَ وَالأَوصافَ التي تَعَلَّمتَها!
lines.english: Now let us test the colors and descriptions you have learned!
lines.transliteration: Al-aana li-nakhtabiru al-alwaan wal-awsaaf allati ta'allamtaha!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يُحكى أَنَّ السِّندِبادَ رَأى بَحرًا أَزرَقَ كالسَّماء يَلتَقي بِأَرضٍ خَضراءَ كَالزُّمُرُّد.
lines.english: It is said that Sinbad saw a sea blue as the sky meeting land green as emerald.
lines.transliteration: Yuhkaa anna as-Sindibaada ra'aa bahran azraqa kas-samaa' yaltaqi bi-ardin khadhraa'a kaz-zumuruud.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَرَأى صَحراءَ حَمراءَ تَحتَ شَمسٍ ذَهَبِيَّة — الأَلوانُ هِيَ لُغَةُ الجَمال!
lines.english: And he saw a red desert under a golden sun — colors are the language of beauty!
lines.transliteration: Wa ra'aa sahraa'a hamraa'a tahta shamsin dhahabiyyah — al-alwaanu hiya lughatu al-jamaal!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي القِصَصِ العَظيمَة، كُلُّ لَونٍ لَهُ مَعنى. الأَحمَرُ لِلخَطَر، الأَزرَقُ لِلأَمَل.
lines.english: In great stories, every color has meaning. Red for danger, blue for hope.
lines.transliteration: Fil-qisasi al-'azhiimah, kullu lawning lahu ma'na. Al-ahmar lil-khatar, al-azraq lil-amal.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الآنَ أَنتَ تَعرِفُ سِرَّ الرَّاوي: اِستَخدِم الأَلوانَ وَالأَوصافَ لِتُحيِيَ القِصَّة!
lines.english: Now you know the storyteller's secret: use colors and descriptions to bring the story to life!
lines.transliteration: Al-aana anta ta'rifu sirra ar-raawi: istakhdim al-alwaana wal-awsaaf li-tuhyiya al-qissah!

personality.catchphrase: يُحْكى أَنَّ — yuhkaa anna (It is said that...)

name: Wanderer Ali
role: Teaches useful phrases and verbs

greeting.arabic: يَا سَلَامْ! مُسَافِرٌ آخَرُ! أَهْلًا بِكَ!
greeting.english: Oh wow! Another traveler! Welcome!
greeting.transliteration: Ya salaam! Musaafirun aakhar! Ahlan bik!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا! أَنَا عَلِيٌّ الرَّحَّالَةُ! سَافَرْتُ مِنَ المَشْرِقِ إِلَى المَغْرِبِ!
lines.english: Welcome! I am Ali the Wanderer! I have traveled from east to west!
lines.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan! Ana 'Aliyyun ar-rahaalah! Saafartu min al-mashriqi ila al-maghrib!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فِي السَّفَرِ تَحْتَاجُ أَنْ تَعْرِفَ أَفْعَالًا مُهِمَّةً. سَأُعَلِّمُكَ!
lines.english: In travel you need to know important verbs. I will teach you!
lines.transliteration: Fi as-safar tahtaaju an ta'rifa af'aalan muhimmah. Sa-u'allimuk!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ذَهَبَ. ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى كُلِّ مَكَانٍ! ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى الجِبَالِ وَالبِحَارِ.
lines.english: To go. I went to every place! I went to the mountains and the seas.
lines.transliteration: Dhahaba. Dhahabtu ila kulli makaan! Dhahabtu ila al-jibaal wal-bihaar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَاءَ. وَدَائِمًا أَجِيءُ إِلَى هَذَا المُخَيَّمِ، فَهُوَ بَيْتِي!
lines.english: To come. And I always come to this camp, for it is my home!
lines.transliteration: Jaa'a. Wa daa'iman ajii'u ila hadha al-mukhayyam, fa-huwa bayti!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَشَى. مَشَيْتُ أَيَّامًا فِي الصَّحْرَاءِ تَحْتَ الشَّمْسِ الحَارَّةِ!
lines.english: To walk. I walked for days in the desert under the hot sun!
lines.transliteration: Masha. Mashaytu ayyaaman fi as-sahraa' tahta ash-shamsi al-haarrah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَلَاثَةُ أَفْعَالٍ لِلسَّفَرِ! هَيَّا نَخْتَبِرُكَ!
lines.english: Three verbs for travel! Let's test you!
lines.transliteration: Thalaathatu af'aalin lis-safar! Hayya nakhtabiruk!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جِئْتَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى! مُمْتَازٌ! فِي السَّفَرِ تَحْتَاجُ حَوَاسَّكَ.
lines.english: You came again! Excellent! In travel you need your senses.
lines.transliteration: Ji'ta marratan ukhra! Mumtaaz! Fi as-safar tahtaaju hawaassak.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَأَى. رَأَيْتُ أَشْيَاءَ عَجِيبَةً فِي رِحْلَاتِي! وَاحَاتٌ وَسَطَ الرِّمَالِ!
lines.english: To see. I saw amazing things on my journeys! Oases in the middle of the sand!
lines.transliteration: Ra'a. Ra'aytu ashyaa'a 'ajiibatan fi rihlaati! Waahaat wasata ar-rimaal!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سَمِعَ. سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ الذِّئْبِ فِي اللَّيْلِ. كَانَ مُخِيفًا!
lines.english: To hear. I heard the sound of the wolf at night. It was scary!
lines.transliteration: Sami'a. Sami'tu sawta adh-dhi'bi fi al-layl. Kaana mukhiifan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَكَلَّمَ. تَكَلَّمْتُ مَعَ نَاسٍ كَثِيرِينَ بِلُغَاتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ!
lines.english: To speak. I spoke with many people in different languages!
lines.transliteration: Takallama. Takallamtu ma'a naasin kathiiriin bi-lughaat mukhtalifah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فَهِمَ. أَهَمُّ شَيْءٍ هُوَ أَنْ تَفْهَمَ النَّاسَ!
lines.english: To understand. The most important thing is to understand people!
lines.transliteration: Fahima. Ahammu shay'in huwa an tafhama an-naas!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَرْبَعَةُ أَفْعَالٍ جَدِيدَةٍ! لِنَرَ كَمْ تَذْكُرُ!
lines.english: Four new verbs! Let's see how much you remember!
lines.transliteration: Arba'atu af'aalin jadiidah! Li-nara kam tadhkur!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَا صَدِيقِي! اليَوْمَ سَأُعَلِّمُكَ عِبَارَاتٍ مُفِيدَةً لِلسَّفَرِ.
lines.english: My friend! Today I will teach you useful phrases for travel.
lines.transliteration: Ya sadiiqi! Al-yawma sa-u'allimuka 'ibaaraatin mufiidah lis-safar.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِنْدَمَا تَفْهَمُ شَخْصًا، قُلْ: أَنَا أَفْهَمُ! هَذَا يُفْرِحُ النَّاسَ.
lines.english: When you understand someone, say: I understand! This makes people happy.
lines.transliteration: 'Indama tafhamu shakhsan, qul: Ana afhamu! Hadha yufrihu an-naas.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَإِذَا لَمْ تَفْهَمْ، لَا تَخْجَلْ! قُلْ: لَا أَفْهَمُ.
lines.english: And if you don't understand, don't be shy! Say: I don't understand.
lines.transliteration: Wa idha lam tafham, la takhajal! Qul: La afhamu.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَهَمُّ عِبَارَةٍ: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ مُسَاعَدَتِي؟ هَذِهِ أَنْقَذَتْنِي مَرَّاتٍ كَثِيرَةً!
lines.english: And the most important phrase: Can you help me? This saved me many times!
lines.transliteration: Wa ahammu 'ibaarah: Hal yumkinuka musaa'adati? Hadhihi anqadhatni marraat kathiirah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ العِبَارَاتُ سَتُسَاعِدُكَ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ! اِخْتِبَارٌ أَخِيرٌ!
lines.english: These phrases will help you everywhere! One last test!
lines.transliteration: Hadhihi al-'ibaaaraat satusaa'iduka fi kulli makaan! Ikhtibaarun akhiir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يا أَهْلاً! الرِّحْلَةُ مُغامَرَة دائِماً
lines.english: Hey there! The journey is always an adventure.
lines.transliteration: ya ahlan! ar-rihla mughaamara daa'iman

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الرِّحلَة لا تَنتَهي — كُلَّما سافَرتَ وَجَدتَ أَسرار جَديدَة
lines.english: The journey never ends — the more you travel, the more secrets you find.
lines.transliteration: ar-rihla laa tantahii — kullama saafarta wajadta asraar jadiida

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَذَكَّر: "السَّفَر يُوسِّع العَقل" — وَاللُّغَة تُوسِّعُهُ أَكثَر
lines.english: Remember: "Travel broadens the mind" — and language broadens it more.
lines.transliteration: tadhakkar: 'as-safar yuwassi' al-'aql' — wal-lugha tuwassi'uh akthar

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الصَّحْراءُ مَليئَة بِالأَسْرار
lines.english: The desert is full of secrets.
lines.transliteration: as-sahraa' malii'a bil-asraar

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَأَيْتُ أَماكِن لا يَعْرِفُها أَحَد
lines.english: I have seen places no one knows.
lines.transliteration: ra'aytu amakin laa ya'rifuhaa ahad

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: واحات مَخْفِيَّة، كُهوف قَديمَة، آثار ضائِعَة
lines.english: Hidden oases, ancient caves, lost ruins.
lines.transliteration: waahaat makhfiyya, kuhuuf qadiima, aathaar daa'i'a

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سافَرْتُ إِلى بِلادٍ كَثيرَة
lines.english: I have traveled to many lands.
lines.transliteration: saafart ilaa bilaad kathiira

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: في الشَّمال، الجِبالُ مُغَطّاة بِالثَّلْج
lines.english: In the north, the mountains are covered with snow.
lines.transliteration: fish-shamaal, al-jibaal mughattaa bith-thalj

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَفي الجَنوب، البِحارُ لا نِهايَة لَها
lines.english: And in the south, the seas have no end.
lines.transliteration: wa fil-januub, al-bihaar laa nihaaya lahaa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْتاجُ شَريك لِرِحْلَة اسْتِكْشاف
lines.english: I need a partner for an exploration journey.
lines.transliteration: ahtaaju shariik li-rihla istikshaa ف

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل أَنتَ شُجاع كِفايَة؟
lines.english: Are you brave enough?
lines.transliteration: hal anta shujaа' kifaaya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَا صَدِيقِي، هَلْ تَعْرِفُ أَنَّ العَالَمَ الإِسْلَامِيَّ امْتَدَّ مِنَ الأَنْدَلُسِ إِلَى إِنْدُونِيسِيَا؟
lines.english: My friend, did you know the Islamic world stretched from Al-Andalus to Indonesia?
lines.transliteration: Yaa sadiiqi, hal ta'rifu anna al-'aalam al-islaamiyy imtadda min al-Andalus ilaa Induniisiya?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رَأَيْتُ قُرْطُبَةَ، مَدِينَةَ النُّورِ! وَبَغْدَادَ، قُبَّةَ الإِسْلَامِ! وَسَمَرْقَنْدَ الجَمِيلَة!
lines.english: I saw Cordoba, the City of Light! And Baghdad, the Dome of Islam! And beautiful Samarkand!
lines.transliteration: Ra'aytu Qurtuba, madiinata an-nuur! Wa Baghdad, qubba al-islaam! Wa Samarqand al-jamiila!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الكَلِمَة التي تَحتاجُها في كُلِّ مَكان: أَيْن؟
lines.english: The word you need everywhere: where?
lines.transliteration: Al-kalima allatii tahtaajuhaa fii kulli makaan: ayna?
lines.culturalNote: The word "safari" comes from Arabic "safar" (سَفَر), meaning journey or travel. Arab traders and explorers carried their language across three continents, from Spain to Indonesia.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالكَلِمَة الثَّانِيَة: اِذهَب — لِأَنَّ الحَيَاةَ تَبدَأُ حِينَ تَذهَب!
lines.english: And the second word: go — because life begins when you leave!
lines.transliteration: Wa al-kalima ath-thaaniya: idh-hab — li-anna al-hayaata tabda' hiina tadhhab!

choices.english: What is the farthest place you went?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: آه، قُرطُبَة! في القَرنِ العَاشِر كانَت أَكبَر مَدينَة في أُوروبَّا — مِليون نَسَمَة!
lines.english: Ah, Cordoba! In the 10th century it was the largest city in Europe — a million people!
lines.transliteration: Aah, Qurtuba! Fi al-qarn al-'aashir kaanat akbar madiina fii Uurubba — milyuun nasamah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: فيها مَكتَبَة بِسَبعِمائَة وَسَبعين أَلف كِتاب! نُور العَقل في زَمان الظَّلام!
lines.english: It had a library of 770,000 books! A light of the mind in an age of darkness!
lines.transliteration: Fiihaa maktaba bi-sab'imi'a wa sab'iina alf kitaab! Nuur al-'aql fii zamaan az-zalaam!
lines.culturalNote: "Caravan" comes from Persian via Arabic "qaafila" (قَافِلَة). Arab caravanserais — roadside inns spaced a day's journey apart — formed the world's first commercial highway network, from Morocco to China.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَلَّم: القِرَاءَة — لِأَنَّ المَعرِفَة هِيَ الزَّادُ الحَقِيقِيُّ لِلمُسَافِر!
lines.english: Learn: reading — because knowledge is the true provisions of a traveler!
lines.transliteration: Ta'allam: al-qiraa'a — li-anna al-ma'rifa hiya az-zaad al-haqiiqi lil-musaafir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَبعَد مَكان؟ وَصَلتُ إِلى الهِند، وَرَأَيتُ تُجَّاراً عَرَباً في كُلِّ مِيناء!
lines.english: Farthest place? I reached India, and saw Arab traders in every port!
lines.transliteration: Ab'ad makaan? Wasaltu ilaa al-Hind, wa ra'aytu tujjaaran 'Araban fii kulli miinaa'!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: العَرَبُ كانوا الجِسرَ بَينَ الشَّرقِ والغَرب. كَانوا يُتَرجِمون ويُجَارون ويَبنون.
lines.english: Arabs were the bridge between East and West. They translated, traded, and built.
lines.transliteration: Al-'Arab kaanuu al-jisr bayna ash-sharq wal-gharb. Kaanuu yutarjimuun wa yujaarirun wa yabbuun.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَذكَّر: الشَّرق — مَطلَع الشَّمس. مِن هُناكَ تَأتي الحِكمَة!
lines.english: Remember: east — where the sun rises. From there comes wisdom!
lines.transliteration: Tadhakkar: ash-sharq — matla' ash-shams. Min hunaaka ta'ti al-hikma!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أُحِبُّ الأَلغَاز! إِليكَ لُغزٌ: مَاذَا يَحمِلُ المُسَافِر في دَاخِلِه وَلا يَسقُط مِنه؟
lines.english: I love riddles! Here is one: What does the traveler carry inside and never drops?
lines.transliteration: Uhibbu al-alghaz! Ilayk lugz: maadha yahmilu al-musaafir fii daakhilihi wa laa yasqut minh?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ذَاكِرَتُه! كُلُّ مَكان زَارَه، كُلُّ وَجه رَآه — يَعيش في القَلب إِلى الأَبَد!
lines.english: His memory! Every place he visited, every face he saw — lives in the heart forever!
lines.transliteration: Dhaakiratuh! Kullu makaan zaarahu, kullu wajh ra'aahu — ya'iish fil-qalb ilaa al-abad!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَلَّم: القَلب — لِأَنَّ الرَّحَّالَة يَعيش بِقَلبِه قَبلَ قَدَمَيه!
lines.english: Learn: the heart — because the wanderer lives by his heart before his feet!
lines.transliteration: Ta'allam: al-qalb — li-anna ar-rahhaalah ya'iish bi-qalbih qabla qadamaih!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَأَيضاً: القَدَم — لِأَنَّ الرَّحَّالَة يَعيش بِقَدَمَيه كَذَلِك!
lines.english: And also: the foot — because the wanderer also lives by his feet!
lines.transliteration: Wa aydan: al-qadam — li-anna ar-rahhaalah ya'iish bi-qadamaih kadhalik!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حِكمَة السَّفَر الأولى: تَعَلَّم دَائِماً كَلِمَة شُكراً بِلُغَة أَهلِ المَكَان.
lines.english: First travel wisdom: always learn how to say thank you in the local language.
lines.transliteration: Hikmat as-safar al-uulaa: ta'allam daa'iman kalimata shukran bi-lughat ahl al-makaan.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالحِكمَة الثَّانِيَة: لا تَخَف مِنَ المَجهول — فَفِيه الكَنز الحَقِيقِيّ!
lines.english: Second wisdom: do not fear the unknown — for therein lies the true treasure!
lines.transliteration: Wa al-hikma ath-thaaniya: laa takhaf min al-majhuul — fa-fiih al-kanz al-haqiiqi!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَشي هُوَ الحِيَاة. تَعَلَّم: مَشى — وَامشِ دَائِماً إِلى الأَمَام!
lines.english: Walking is life. Learn: he walked — and always walk forward!
lines.transliteration: Al-mashi huwa al-hayaah. Ta'allam: mashaa — wamshi daa'iman ilaa al-amaam!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: رِحلَتُكَ لا تَنتَهي يَا صَدِيقي. حَتَّى في غُرفَتِك، عَقلُكَ يُسَافِر!
lines.english: Your journey never ends, my friend. Even in your room, your mind travels!
lines.transliteration: Rihlatuk laa tantahii yaa sadiiqi. Hattaa fii ghurfatik, 'aqluk yusaafir!

personality.catchphrase: الرِّحْلَةُ مُغامَرَة — ar-rihla mughaamara (The journey is an adventure)

name: Guide Salim
role: Teaches mountain animals and adjectives

greeting.arabic: مَرْحَباً يا مُسافِر. الجَبَل يَنتَظِرُك
greeting.english: Welcome, traveler. The mountain awaits you.
greeting.transliteration: marhaban ya musaafir. al-jabal yantaziruk

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَنا سَليم، مُرشِد هَذا الجَبَل
lines.english: I am Salim, guide of this mountain.
lines.transliteration: ana saliim, murshid haadha al-jabal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عِشتُ هُنا سِنين طَويلَة. أَعرِفُ كُلَّ حَيَوان
lines.english: I have lived here many years. I know every animal.
lines.transliteration: ishtu hunaa siniin tawiila. a'rifu kulla hayawaan

choices.english: I want to know the place first

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اُنظُر إِلى السَّماء. هَل تَرى ذَلِك الطَّيْر الكَبير؟
lines.english: Look at the sky. Do you see that big bird?
lines.transliteration: unzur ila as-samaa'. hal taraa dhaalik at-tayr al-kabiir?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ذَلِكَ نِسْرٌ — مَلِكُ الطُّيور
lines.english: That is an eagle — king of the birds.
lines.transliteration: dhaalika nisrun — maliku at-tuyuur

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِنتَبِه! بَيْنَ الصُّخور تَعيشُ الحَيَّةٌ
lines.english: Be careful! Among the rocks lives the snake.
lines.transliteration: intabih! bayna as-sukhuur ta'iishu al-hayyatun

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَهُناكَ أَرْنَبٌ — سَريعٌ جِدّاً في القَفْز
lines.english: And there is a rabbit — very fast at jumping.
lines.transliteration: wa hunaaka arnabun — sarii'un jiddan fil-qafz

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَلاثَة حَيَوانات. هَل حَفِظتَها؟
lines.english: Three animals. Did you memorize them?
lines.transliteration: thalaathat hayawaanaat. hal hafidtahaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدتَ. جَيِّد. الجَبَل فيهِ حَيَوانات أَكثَر
lines.english: You returned. Good. The mountain has more animals.
lines.transliteration: udta. jayyid. al-jabal fiihi hayawaanaat akthar

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الأَسَدٌ — أَقْوى حَيَوان في الجَبَل
lines.english: The lion — the strongest animal in the mountain.
lines.transliteration: al-asadun — aqwaa hayawaan fil-jabal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: النَّمْلَةٌ — صَغيرَة لَكِنَّها قَوِيَّة
lines.english: The ant — small but strong.
lines.transliteration: an-namlatun — saghiira laakinnaha qawiyya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القِطَّةٌ — تَعيشُ مَعَ النّاس في القَرْيَة
lines.english: The cat — lives with the people in the village.
lines.transliteration: al-qittatun — ta'iishu ma'a an-naas fil-qarya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الكَلْبٌ — يَحرُسُ البُيوت
lines.english: The dog — guards the houses.
lines.transliteration: al-kalbun — yahrusu al-buyuut

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَربَعَة حَيَوانات جَديدَة. اِختَبِر نَفسَك
lines.english: Four new animals. Test yourself.
lines.transliteration: arba'at hayawaanaat jadiida. ikhtabir nafsak

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الحَيَوانات لَها صِفات. لِنَتَعَلَّم بَعْض الصِّفات
lines.english: Animals have qualities. Let's learn some adjectives.
lines.transliteration: al-hayawaanaat lahaa sifaat. linata'allam ba'd as-sifaat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَدِيدٌ — مِثل الثَّلج الجَديد عَلى الجَبَل
lines.english: New — like the new snow on the mountain.
lines.transliteration: jadiidun — mithl ath-thalj al-jadiid ala al-jabal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَدِيمٌ — مِثل هَذِهِ الصُّخور القَديمَة
lines.english: Old — like these old rocks.
lines.transliteration: qadiimun — mithl haadhihi as-sukhuur al-qadiima

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: جَمِيلٌ — مِثل مَنظَر الجَبَل عِندَ الغُروب
lines.english: Beautiful — like the mountain view at sunset.
lines.transliteration: jamiilun — mithl manzar al-jabal inda al-ghuruub

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَلِمات مُهِمَّة. هَيّا نَرى ماذا تَذكُر
lines.english: Important words. Let's see what you remember.
lines.transliteration: kalimaat muhimma. hayyaa naraa maadha tadhkur

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَذِهِ قَرْيَة الجَبَل. مَكان هادِئ وَجَميل
lines.english: This is the mountain village. A quiet and beautiful place.
lines.transliteration: haadhihi qaryat al-jabal. makaan haadi' wa jamiil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: زَهراء الحائِكَة تَصنَعُ أَجمَل الثِّياب
lines.english: Zahra the weaver makes the finest clothes.
lines.transliteration: zahraa' al-haa'ika tasna'u ajmal ath-thiyaab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَخَديجَة المُعالِجَة تَعرِفُ كُلَّ الأَعشاب
lines.english: And Khadija the healer knows all the herbs.
lines.transliteration: wa khadiija al-mu'aalija ta'rifu kulla al-a'shaab

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً! أَنا سَليم، دَليلُكَ. اِتَّبِعْني
lines.english: Welcome! I am Salim, your guide. Follow me.
lines.transliteration: ahlan! ana saliim, daliiluk. ittabi'nii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الاِتِّجاهاتُ مُهِمَّة! دَعْني أُعَلِّمُك
lines.english: Directions are important! Let me teach you.
lines.transliteration: al-ittijahaat muhimma! da'nii u'allimuk

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَمين — right، يَسار — left
lines.english: Yamiin — right, yasaar — left.
lines.transliteration: yamiin — right, yasaar — left

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَمام — front، خَلْف — behind
lines.english: Amaam — front, khalf — behind.
lines.transliteration: amaam — front, khalf — behind

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هُناكَ ثَمان مَناطِق في العالَم
lines.english: There are eight zones in the world.
lines.transliteration: hunaaka thamaan manaatiq fil-aalam

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الواحَة، المَكتَبَة، السُّوق، البَدْو، وَالمَزيد
lines.english: The oasis, the library, the market, the Bedouin camp, and more.
lines.transliteration: al-waaha, al-maktaba, as-suuq, al-badw, wal-maziid

choices.english: I want to visit them all

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحْتاجُ مُساعِد لِرَسْمِ خَريطَة المَنطَقَة
lines.english: I need an assistant to map the area.
lines.transliteration: ahtaaju musaa'id li-rasm khariitat al-mantaqa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: زُرْ كُلَّ المَناطِق وَعُدْ إِلَيّ
lines.english: Visit all the zones and return to me.
lines.transliteration: zur kull al-manaatiq wa ud ilayya

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَال، أُرِيكَ سِرَّ المُلَّاحِين العَرَب: النُّجوم هِيَ خَريطَتُنا!
lines.english: Come, I show you the secret of Arab navigators: the stars are our map!
lines.transliteration: Ta'aal, uriika sirr al-mullaahin al-'Arab: an-nujuum hiya khaaritatunaa!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كَلِمَة "zenith" الإِنجليزِيَّة مِن العَرَبِيَّة "سَمت" — أَي الاتِّجَاه في السَّمَاء!
lines.english: The English "zenith" is from Arabic "samt" — meaning direction in the sky!
lines.transliteration: Kalima 'zenith' al-injliiziyya min al-'arabiyya 'samt' — ay al-ittijjah fii as-samaa'!
lines.culturalNote: "Zenith" comes from Arabic "samt" (سَمت, direction). "Nadir" comes from Arabic "nadhiir" (نَظير, opposite). Both entered European science through Arab astronomical texts of the 9th-12th centuries.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَجمُ الشِّمَال يَدُلُّنا على الشَّمَال دَائِماً. تَعَلَّم: الشَّمَال!
lines.english: The North Star always points north. Learn: ash-shamaal (north)!
lines.transliteration: Najm ash-shimaal yadullunaa 'alaa ash-shamaal daa'iman. Ta'allam: ash-shamaal!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَعَكسُه: الجَنوب! مِن الشَّمَال تَعرِف كُلَّ شَيء!
lines.english: And its opposite: south! From north you know everything!
lines.transliteration: Wa 'aksuh: al-januub! Min ash-shamaal ta'rif kull shay'!

choices.english: Who was the greatest Arab navigator?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مُمتاز! الجِهَات الأَربَع. الشَّمَال وَالجَنوب عَرَفتَهُمَا. الآن: الشَّرق!
lines.english: Excellent! Four directions. You know north and south. Now: east!
lines.transliteration: Mumtaaz! Al-jihaat al-arba'. Ash-shamaal wal-januub 'araftahumaa. Al-aan: ash-sharq!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الشَّرق: مَطلَع الشَّمس. الغَرب: مَغرِبُها. بَينَهُما حَيَاتُنا كُلُّها!
lines.english: East: sunrise. West: sunset. Between them is all of our lives!
lines.transliteration: Ash-sharq: matla' ash-shams. Al-gharb: maghribuhaa. Baynahumaa hayaatunaaa kulluhaa!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَالغَرب! مَغرِب الشَّمس، مَوطِن الأَنْدَلُس والمَغرِب العَظيم.
lines.english: And west! Where the sun sets, homeland of Andalusia and the great Maghreb.
lines.transliteration: Wa al-gharb! Maghrib ash-shams, mawtin al-Andalus wal-Maghrib al-'aziim.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَيَّا نَختَبِر! مَن يَعرِف الجِهَات لَن يَضِيع أَبَداً!
lines.english: Let's test! One who knows the directions will never be lost!
lines.transliteration: Hayya nakhtabir! Man ya'rif al-jihaat lan yadii' abadan!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحسَنتَ! الجِهَات عَلى طَرف لِسَانِك الآن. أَنتَ مُلَّاح حَقِيقِي!
lines.english: Well done! The directions are on the tip of your tongue now. You are a true navigator!
lines.transliteration: Ahsanta! Al-jihaat 'alaa taraf lisaanik al-aan. Anta mullaahin haqiiqi!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحمَد بن مَاجِد! شَيخُ البَحَّارَة العَرَب — كَتَبَ أَربَعين كِتَاباً في فُنون المَلَاحَة!
lines.english: Ahmad ibn Majid! Master of Arab sailors — he wrote forty books on the arts of navigation!
lines.transliteration: Ahmad ibn Maajid! Shaykh al-bahhaara al-'Arab — kataba arba'iina kitaaban fii funuun al-malaaha!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قِيلَ أَنَّهُ دَلَّ فَاسكو دا غَاما على طَريق الهِند عَام 1498. المَعرِفَة العَرَبِيَّة فَتَحَت البَحَار!
lines.english: It is said he guided Vasco da Gama to India in 1498. Arab knowledge opened the seas!
lines.transliteration: Qiila annahu dalla Vaasco da Gama 'alaa tariiq al-Hind 'aam 1498. Al-ma'rifa al-'arabiyya fatahat al-bihaar!
lines.culturalNote: Ahmad ibn Majid (c.1421-1500 CE), called "The Lion of the Sea" (Asad al-Bahr), wrote comprehensive guides to Indian Ocean navigation. His star charts and wind knowledge were unmatched in his era.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَتَعَلَّم: فَوق — لِأَنَّ النُّجوم دَائِماً فَوقَنا وَتَدُلُّنا على الطَّريق!
lines.english: And learn: above — because the stars are always above us guiding our path!
lines.transliteration: Wa ta'allam: fawqa — li-anna an-nujuum daa'iman fawqanaa wa tadullunaa 'alaa at-tariiq!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: يَا صَاحِبي، قَبلَ أَيِّ رِحلَة في الجَبَل، اِحفَظ هَذِهِ القَوَاعِد الثَّلاث!
lines.english: My companion, before any mountain journey, memorize these three rules!
lines.transliteration: Yaa saahib, qabla ayyi rihla fil-jabal, ihfaz haadhihi al-qawaa'id ath-thalaath!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَاعِدَة الأولى: اُنظُر دَائِماً إِلى السَّمَاء. المَطَر في الجَبَل يَأتي بِلا إِنذَار!
lines.english: Rule one: always watch the sky. Mountain rain comes without warning!
lines.transliteration: Al-qaa'ida al-uulaa: unzur daa'iman ilaa as-samaa'. Al-matar fil-jabal ya'ti bilaa indhaar!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَاعِدَة الثَّانِيَة: اِعرِف اليَمين واليَسَار دَائِماً. التَّرَدُّد في الجَبَل خَطير!
lines.english: Rule two: always know right and left. Hesitation in the mountains is dangerous!
lines.transliteration: Al-qaa'ida ath-thaaniya: i'rif al-yamiin wal-yasaar daa'iman. At-taraddud fil-jabal khatir!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: القَاعِدَة الثَّالِثَة: الرِّيح تُخبِرُكَ بِكُلِّ شَيء — اِستَمِع لِلرِّيح!
lines.english: Rule three: the wind tells you everything — listen to the wind!
lines.transliteration: Al-qaa'ida ath-thaalitha: ar-riyaah tukhbiruka bi-kulli shay' — ista'mil lir-riyaah!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: اِذهَب الآن — لَكِن كُن حَذِراً! الطَّريقُ يَنتَظِرُكَ وَأَنا هُنا دَائِماً.
lines.english: Go now — but be careful! The path awaits you and I am always here.
lines.transliteration: Idh-hab al-aan — laakin kun hadiran! At-tariiq yantaziruk wa ana hunaa daa'iman.

personality.catchphrase: اِتَّبِعْني — ittabi'nii (Follow me)

name: Weaver Zahra
role: Teaches clothing vocabulary

greeting.arabic: أَهْلاً وَسَهْلاً! تَعال شُوف أَعمالي
greeting.english: Welcome! Come see my work.
greeting.transliteration: ahlan wa sahlan! ta'aal shuuf a'maalii

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: مَرْحَباً! أَنا زَهراء الحائِكَة
lines.english: Hello! I am Zahra the weaver.
lines.transliteration: marhaban! ana zahraa' al-haa'ika

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَحيكُ الثِّياب مُنذُ كُنتُ صَغيرَة. كُلّ قِطعَة لَها اسم
lines.english: I've been weaving clothes since I was little. Every piece has a name.
lines.transliteration: ahiiku ath-thiyaab mundhu kuntu saghiira. kullu qit'a lahaa ism

choices.english: Teach me the names of clothes

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: لِنَبدَأ بِالأَساسِيّات. هَذا ثَوْب — لِباس تَقليدِيّ
lines.english: Let's start with the basics. This is a thobe — a traditional garment.
lines.transliteration: linabda' bil-asaasiyyaat. haadha thawb — libaas taqlidiiy

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَهَذا فُسْتَان — لِباس جَميل لِلنِّساء
lines.english: And this is a dress — a beautiful garment for women.
lines.transliteration: wa haadha fustaan — libaas jamiil lin-nisaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وَقَمِيص — يَلبَسُهُ الرِّجال وَالنِّساء
lines.english: And a shirt — worn by men and women.
lines.transliteration: wa qamiis — yalbasuhuu ar-rijaal wan-nisaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَلاث قِطَع مِن الثِّياب. هَل تَذكُرها؟
lines.english: Three pieces of clothing. Do you remember them?
lines.transliteration: thalaath qita' min ath-thiyaab. hal tadhkuruhaa?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: عُدتَ! عِندي قِطَع أَكثَر لِأُرِيَك
lines.english: You're back! I have more pieces to show you.
lines.transliteration: udta! indii qita' akthar li-uriiyak

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: سِرْوَال — لِلنِّصف الأَسفَل
lines.english: Pants — for the lower half.
lines.transliteration: sirwaal — lin-nisf al-asfal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: وِشَاح — يُغَطّي الرَّأس وَالرَّقَبَة
lines.english: A scarf — covers the head and neck.
lines.transliteration: wishaah — yughattii ar-ra's war-raqaba

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حِذَاء — لِلمَشي عَلى الجَبَل
lines.english: Shoes — for walking on the mountain.
lines.transliteration: hidhaa' — lil-mashii ala al-jabal

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قُبَّعَة — تَحمي مِن الشَّمس
lines.english: A hat — protects from the sun.
lines.transliteration: qubba'a — tahmii min ash-shams

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَربَع قِطَع جَديدَة! هَيّا نَرى
lines.english: Four new pieces! Let's see how you do.
lines.transliteration: arba' qita' jadiida! hayyaa naraa

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ما شاءَ الله! أَنتَ تَتَعَلَّم بِسُرعَة
lines.english: Mashallah! You learn quickly.
lines.transliteration: maa shaa'allaah! anta tata'allam bisur'a

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حِزَام — يَربِطُ الثِّياب حَولَ الوَسَط
lines.english: A belt — ties the clothes around the waist.
lines.transliteration: hizaam — yarbitu ath-thiyaab hawla al-wasat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: حَقِيبَة — لِحَمل الأَشياء
lines.english: A bag — for carrying things.
lines.transliteration: haqiiba — lihaml al-ashyaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: خَاتَم — حِليَة لِلإِصبَع. أَصنَعُها مِن الفِضَّة
lines.english: A ring — jewelry for the finger. I make them from silver.
lines.transliteration: khaatam — hilya lil-isba'. asna'uhaa min al-fidda

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: آخِر ثَلاث كَلِمات! هَيّا نَختَبِر
lines.english: The last three words! Let's test.
lines.transliteration: aakhir thalaath kalimaat! hayyaa nakhtabir

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: شُكراً! أُمّي عَلَّمَتني الحِياكَة وَأَنا صَغيرَة
lines.english: Thank you! My mother taught me weaving when I was young.
lines.transliteration: shukran! ummii allamatnii al-hiyaaka wa ana saghiira

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: كُلّ خَيط لَهُ لَون وَمَعنى. تَعال أُعَلِّمك الأَسماء
lines.english: Every thread has a color and meaning. Come, I'll teach you the names.
lines.transliteration: kullu khayt lahuu lawn wa ma'naa. ta'aal u'allimak al-asmaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: أَهْلاً. الجَمالُ في التَّفاصيل
lines.english: Welcome. Beauty is in the details.
lines.transliteration: ahlan. al-jamaal fit-tafaasiil

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ماذا تُريد؟
lines.english: What do you want?
lines.transliteration: maadha turiid?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَلابِسُ فَنّ. دَعْني أُعَلِّمُك
lines.english: Clothing is art. Let me teach you.
lines.transliteration: al-malaabis fann. da'nii u'allimuk

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: ثَوْب — dress، قَميص — shirt
lines.english: Thawb — dress, qamiis — shirt.
lines.transliteration: thawb — dress, qamiis — shirt

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: النَّسيجُ العَرَبيُّ تَقليدٌ قَديم
lines.english: Arabic weaving is an ancient tradition.
lines.transliteration: an-nasii j al-arabii taقليد qadiim

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: نَسْتَخْدِم أَلْواناً طَبيعِيَّة مِنَ النَّباتات
lines.english: We use natural colors from plants.
lines.transliteration: nastakhdim alwaanan tabii'iyya min an-nabaataat

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المَوْضَةُ الجَديدَةُ في السُّوق: الأَزْرَق!
lines.english: The new fashion in the market: blue!
lines.transliteration: al-mawda al-jadiida fis-suuq: al-azraq!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: الجَميعُ يُريدُ أَقْمِشَة زَرْقاء
lines.english: Everyone wants blue fabrics.
lines.transliteration: al-jamii'u yuriidu aqmisha zarqaa'

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: تَعَال! أُرِيكَ شَيئاً جَمِيلاً. هَذِهِ القُماشَة جَاءَت مِن سِرِّ الحَضَارَة الإِسلَامِيَّة.
